items.title: Apple’s purchase commitments jump 28%; BofA sees iPhone ramp ahead
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bank of America reiterated a Buy rating and $380 price target on Apple in a note Wednesday, pointing to a sharp jump in manufacturing purchase commitments that it reads as a sign of an iPhone production ramp and component stockpiling.

items.title: Simon Property Group (SPG) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Analyst Target Increases

That shift aligns with recent Street research, where price targets are clustering higher as analysts refine funds from operations and net operating income assumptions, even while views on risk and entry points remain split. items.title: Bank of America, USAA ink patent agreement
items.summary: The deal allows each company to use the other’s full portfolio of patents. USAA for years has sued – or threatened court action against – banks it says infringe on its remote deposit capture patents.

items.title: Bank of America (BAC) Signals OCC Penalties Over Anti Money Laundering Deficiencies
items.summary: Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) disclosed that it may face monetary penalties tied to deficiencies in its anti money laundering program. The bank indicated that a resolution with the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, or OCC, could be near. This disclosure marks a change from earlier statements that suggested any regulatory outcome was not expected to have a material financial impact.
